1.bug_scenario: The issue is that the RadioButton component in the React package does not currently support a “readOnly” prop. When users pass readOnly to <RadioButton>, nothing changes: the input remains interactive, no special styling is applied, and there is no story or tests to demonstrate or verify read-only behavior. The design screenshots illustrate how “read-only” radio buttons should look and space both vertically and horizontally, matching the enabled component’s measurements but without allowing selection changes.

2.bug_scenario: The issue is that although the RadioButton React component accepts a readOnly prop, it is not actually wired up: the underlying <input> is not marked readOnly, no CSS class is applied to style read-only state per the design diagrams, the read-only variant is missing from the storybook playground, and there are no RTL/unit tests asserting the presence of a read-only class or attribute. The design mocks show color/typography and spacing for read-only radio buttons (vertical and horizontal) which must match enabled styling but not be interactive.
